mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( user_id, total_price, status, ordered_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, total_price AS totalPrice, status, ordered_at AS orderedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id AS orderId, total_price AS totalPrice, status, ordered_at AS orderedAt FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ordered_at DESC

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.name AS userName, SUM(o.total_price) AS totalPurchaseAmount
FROM users u
INNER JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY u.id, u.name
ORDER BY totalPurchaseAmount DESC, u.id ASC
LIMIT #{size}
OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%Y-%m') AS yearMonth, SUM(total_price) AS totalSalesAmount
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND ordered_at >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{start}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND ordered_at < DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{end}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH )
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY yearMonth ASC
